scenes.setting: Harvest Church pews: recognized by smell but past caring, Klein plants the seed — the Mental Terror Candle, the lantern at Emlyn's 'conversion', the hour-a-day compulsion — until the smug Sanguine cracks and begs to go home; Utravsky calmly allows it: 'Emlyn can return home at any time'
scenes.text_anchor: “Father, Bishop, I want to return home, I want to return home, I want to return home!”

scenes.setting: The walk and carriage back to 48 Riverbay Avenue: Emlyn already missing the Harvest Church ('It'll only take an hour…'), penniless for the fare, boasting Sanguine potion mastery — and bowing his thanks, which Klein converts into a fee: a Beyonder medicine for a patient
scenes.text_anchor: “In any case, I must thank you.”
